title: wmpc capability manifest (D-0178 ship 1)
description: The route table's per-repo shape. A repo that exposes a callable capability carries this at its root as capabilities.json. Validated by gate.sh, which supports ONLY the keywords used here and refuses a schema that grows past them.

gate.description: How THIS repo detects a capability change (D-0178 rule 3). Exactly one shape: a path trigger, or an honest `none` with a reason.

triggers.description: Glob paths whose change means a capability may have changed.

granularity.description: What the unit of a capability is in this repo.

on_undetectable.description: What the gate does when it cannot tell what changed. Declared per repo, never fleet-wide.

none.description: Why this repo has no honest detectable trigger. An honest `none` beats a check that fires never or always.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the brain may route. NEED NOT BE COMPLETE (D-0178 rule 3); it grows.

name.description: Stable snake_case, unique across the fleet. A rename is a removal plus an addition.

does.description: One plain sentence, no ids, codes, repo or system names (D-0054).

input.description: JSON Schema for the arguments. additionalProperties MUST be false. Generated from the code where the code already declares a schema (D-0147).

env.description: The NAME of the credential env var, never a value (D-0093).

header.description: The NAME of the header it travels in.

effect.description: Only `read` is ever cache-eligible. A mislabelled effect is this design's highest-consequence defect and has NO automated defence — it is reviewed by a human on every manifest change.

idempotent.description: True only if calling it twice changes nothing anywhere — including a rotated credential written back.

reachable_by.description: Which hosts can actually call it. Empty is the honest encoding of 'the brain cannot call this at all'.

deploy.description: A manifest is a claim about main, not about the running host. A `manual` entry's presence is never evidence it is live.

whitelist_key.description: The cos_whitelist key that authorises an autonomous call, or null for 'nothing may auto-call this'. Never cache-eligible when null.

examples.description: At least one real ask. Few-shot material, not decoration.

costly.description: Read-only but slow or contended (a serialized browser behind a lock). Routing may prefer a cheaper path.
